Settings

Controls

Camera

Right mouse drag to look around

WASD move  QE down / up

Shift move faster  Wheel zoom

Middle mouse drag to pan  F focus on target

Touch

One finger uses the tool, two fingers orbit, pinch to zoom.

Tools

1–9 select tool  Tab spawn menu

Hand: drag anything. Wheel pull/push, F freeze in place while holding.

Weapons: Left mouse fire, R next weapon. Includes knife, sword, axe, flamethrower and taser. Sniper rifle: hold Right mouse (or press Z) for the scope, then move the mouse to aim and click to fire; Wheel zooms, Shift steadies.

Rope: click two points to tie them together.

Control: click a person, then WASD walk, Shift run, Space jump, click to punch.

Drone: with the Control tool, click a kamikaze drone to fly it. Mouse steers (or the arrow keys), W flies where you look, S back, AD sideways, Space/E up, Q down, Shift boost, click or G to blow it up, V switches between its camera and a chase view, Esc lets go.

Spawning onto people: knives, swords, syringes, thrusters and missiles placed on a person stick into them. G on a person switches them on; grab a stuck item to pull it out.

P pause  T slow motion  Ctrl+Z undo spawn

Esc cancel / close menus  H this help  Alt+Enter full screen
